{{Quote|I might be spending the rest of my life rotting away on a miserable detention moon, but I'm going to be sitting back smiling as I think of all the things the Hutts are going to do to you before they finally let you die.|Dugtroy Osck in a message to Boffitt Einer|<ref name="Death Troopers: Recovered Messages from Purge">''[[Death Troopers: Recovered Messages from Purge]]''</ref>}}
'''Dugtroy Osck''', a [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] who was also known as '''Dugtroy the Header''' or '''Dugtroy the Cruel''' by his associates and as '''Inmate ICN-001198''' by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] criminal system, was being transported to a [[Detention area|detention]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]] aboard the [[Imperial prison barge]] [[Purge (prison barge)|''Purge'']]. He was double crossed during a [[Spice/Legends|spice]] run for a [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] clan by another smuggler, [[Boffitt Einer]], who informed the Imperials of Osck's actions and took the shipment himself, thinking that it belonged solely to Osck. Einer was unaware that he had just stolen from the Hutts, notorious as the most vicious crime syndicates in the galaxy, and Osck wrote a letter to him to inform him, though the message intentionally did not state which clan. The letter was recovered aboard ''Purge'' after its occupants were decimated by a [[plague]] so it is unlikely that it reached Einer before it was released to the public for academic purposes in relation to the history of ''Purge''.
